_README: S7F 13.5 penalties. Decided by the meet director and the jury; they are
an INPUT to scoring, not derived from any tracklog, so they live here.
Keyed by task name. Each entry names a pilot by the ID that is also the
IGC filename (0157, or 0157.igc), or by pilot name, and gives one or more
percent_own    % of that pilot's own total for this task
percent_task   % of the task's available points (1000 x taskValidity)
'reason' is REQUIRED on every entry. A deduction a pilot cannot see the
reason for is a deduction they cannot contest.
Pass with --penalties penalties.json. Unmatched pilots are reported, never
